correctness.rationale: For A containing cone apex h, a collision between outside u,v can be resolved by a single appended w only if w belongs to {u,v}∪(N_H(u)△N_H(v)), giving ≤2d+2 repairs (prior). Two disjoint once-subdivided d-stars have degree max d for d≥2 and selecting apex plus terminal leaves leaves exactly the two centers colliding, while each 2d+2 unselected center/intermediate removes that collision; singleton complements cannot dominate, yielding an LDC partition into 2d+3 classes. On wheel K1∨C_m, m≥10, selected A includes h and rim outside U={1,2,3,6,7,8}, with 2,7 the sole collision and any U insertion repairs it; no singleton dominates, giving seven classes. Independently checked direct trace predicate on wheel m=10,11,15,30. All m and d follow from the local proof, not finite enumeration; no C_L wheel optimality claimed.
